text: 民航局相关负责人表示，中秋、国庆假期也是民航旅客出行的高峰，环线游、出境游增速非常明显。假日出行还呈现出去程渐次达峰、回程集中抵离的特点。民航的旅客量有望再创历史同期新高。中国民航局副局长马兵介绍，整体来看，从9月25日到10月7日，全国民航预计运输旅客量3119万人次，日均240万人次，增长率3.6%。单日峰值有望突破260万人次，超过去年同期水平。
text_en: A Civil Aviation Administration official said that the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays are also peak periods for civil aviation passenger travel, with notably rapid growth in round-trip and outbound travel. Holiday travel also shows the characteristics of outbound trips peaking gradually and return trips arriving and departing in a concentrated manner. Civil aviation passenger volume is expected to hit a new high for the same period in history. CAAC Deputy Administrator Ma Bing introduced that overall, from September 25 to October 7, civil aviation nationwide is expected to transport 31.19 million passengers, averaging 2.4 million per day, a growth rate of 3.6%. The single-day peak is expected to exceed 2.6 million passengers, surpassing the level of the same period last year.
